title: MOTION (HUTT for MCOSKER - BLUMENFIELD) relative to funding for street safety improvements in Council District Fifteen (CD 15).
text:
[Council File 26-0011-S24; CD 15]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (HUTT for MCOSKER - BLUMENFIELD) relative to funding for street safety improvements in Council District Fifteen (CD 15).
Recommendation(s) for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. TRANSFER and APPROPRIATE $15,400 in the Council District 15 portion of the Council Discretionary Street Furniture Fund No. 43D/50 to a new Account in the Transportation Trust Fund No. 840/94 entitled "Figueroa St. & Alondra Blvd. Improvements", Account No. TBD for street safety improvements in Council District 15.
2. AUTHORIZE the Department of Transportation to make any corrections, clarifications or revisions to the above fund transfers instructions, including any new instructions, in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion, and including any corrections and changes to fund or account numbers; said corrections / clarifications / changes may be made orally, electronically or by any other means.
